top.title: Court allows Minnesota ban on AI ‘nudify’ apps to proceed
top.summary: A judge denied xAI's request to block Minnesota's ban on apps that use AI to create nude images, allowing the law to take effect while the lawsuit continues.
top.why: If you deploy image-generation or image-editing services, treat sexual-image misuse controls and state-by-state legal review as architecture requirements rather than optional policy work.

top.title: Reddit CEO questions whether Google AI Overviews create value
top.summary: As Reddit's stock falls, its CEO said the company is still looking for a mutually beneficial outcome from Google's AI Overviews and may reconsider its content-licensing deal.
top.why: This is a warning that AI-search licensing arrangements can change when traffic and attribution do not meet expectations, so avoid making retrieval or training-data dependencies your only source of content.

top.title: CostPerPrompt estimates AI API spend from real workloads
top.summary: A new Show HN project provides live AI API pricing and calculators based on real workload characteristics rather than simple per-token comparisons; its early launch has 15 points and seven comments, so adoption and data quality are unproven.
top.why: Use it as a quick independent check on model-selection and budget assumptions, but verify every price and workload estimate against your Azure rate card before committing to a design.
